note: Export request metadata and the immutable erasure receipt hold only IDs, state, times and capability/content digests. Export artifact bytes live in the private media-root file named by the request id: they are a full customer-data copy (customer profile, addresses, order/cart summaries), are removed by erasure cleanup for every request id of the subject, and otherwise expire with the DB capability; the signed periodic tenant worker sweeps final and temporary files with no live committed row under the same advisory lock as construction, including rollback orphans. Response-store bodies for privacy commands contain counts and request ids only.

structures.Sha256Digest: Opaque 32-byte digest of a single-use download capability or of exported artifact bytes; never the token or content itself.
